mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 PM, we are looking at clear skies over Reddan Soccer Park with a temperature of 58 degrees.

The Verona Police Department reported an arrest on Thursday involving a school bus driver accused of O W I, though no injuries were reported. Additionally, the City of Verona has provided an interactive map for residents to easily look up their property zoning districts and ordinances.

It is a busy time in Verona with live music happening today at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness, followed by a full slate of events next week including trivia at Hop Haus and Paddy Mac's.
On Thursday, October 15, Verona officers arrested a school bus driver for O W I near Whalen Road and Fairview Terrace after receiving reports of dangerous driving.
Today's flavor at Culver's is the delicious Mint Cookie. The store is currently open and will be serving up treats until 10 PM tonight, so there is plenty of time to stop by.
